leadText:
Bobby (Japanese: ボビー Bobby) is a character of the day who appeared in The Lonely Deino!. He operates a Pokémon Day Care on . 

Bobby had never taken care of s before and was struggling to handle three . He encountered and while trying to find the runaway Deino.

Immediately, volunteered to help him take care of Deino, as she was from the Village of Dragons and had a lot of experience with them. Bobby agreed to let her help, and also allowed Ash and to help take care of Deino and the other Pokémon. Bobby, Ash, and Cilan took care of all of the other Pokémon, while Iris took care of one of the Deino, which was shy. He thanked them for all their hard work after the last Deino was returned to its , and the group left on their way to Driftveil City.

In the English dub, Bobby tends to speak in third person.
